notes.title: How to give feedback / report a bug about Orb Fort
notes.content: Thanks for playing this game. If you want to give feedback about it you can do so by filling this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfGaEWMEW0-mwWR416_Y6-QaHLFTF9k3QSaKlLoVaAj1PPu2g/viewform?usp=sf_link]Google form[/url].
